summary: Defines the exact external-agent caller contract for all 21 scoped controlled AI graphics tools. The caller may submit these private route envelopes to the mounted canonical tool-call route when the scoped flags are enabled. CPU/static and browser-runtime tools execute their controlled local packages; GPU/model tools invoke the on-demand adapter and keep local GPU/model runtime cold unless an explicit approved local-dev runtime request supplies real inputs.

all21ControlledRouteExecutionSmoke.scope: authoritative all-21 controlled route caller proof

nextExternalAgentAction.controlled21Tools: POST /api/ai-graphics/external-beta/tool-call with the matching requestEnvelope when the route mount and scoped controlled execution flags are enabled.
nextExternalAgentAction.gpuModel8Tools: Call through the controlled route for on-demand adapter admission. Local GPU/model runtime stays cold unless the request explicitly supplies approved local-dev runtime inputs and private proof refs.
